title: Verificación: Gemma 4 12B native context more realistically 131K than advertised 256K
summary: Claim revisado: Gemma 4 12B has 256K native context (from @analogalok and official posts). Evidencia: Direct reply in the 21 t/s RTX 4060 thread noting practical limit appears closer to 131K.. Caveat editorial: Official/native context length marketing vs real usable context in current implementations (llama.cpp GGUF).. Reproducibilidad: medium - no new benchmark, but direct observation in active discussion thread.
